input.quote: (k) REPRESENTATION BY COUNSEL. Each party acknowledges that it has had the opportunity to be represented by separate independent counsel in the negotiation of this Agreement
input.rationale: There is no insurance covenant anywhere in the Agreement: the only reference to \"insurance\" is a pass-through of charges payable by Licensee (p0051), and General Provisions (p0144-p0159) contains no coverage requirement. Licensor hosts the Licensed Technology and receives our market data and trading orders, so the absence of any coverage is walk-away territory under the rule. We insert the shortest fallback covenant (E&O USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy USD 2,000,000) in General Provisions; the preferred general liability, higher cyber limit, workers' compensation and certificate elements are not pursued at this fallback level.

mappings.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.

proposal.summary: Insert a short insurance covenant (E&O USD 1M; cyber USD 2M) in General Provisions.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance covenant even though Licensor hosts the Licensed Technology and handles our market data and orders, so we have added the short fallback covenant: E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy of USD 2,000,000. Our preferred position also includes general liability, higher cyber limits and certificates, but we are content with these fallback limits.

ops.text: INSURANCE. Licensor shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 and cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.
